people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
translations.bsb: In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.
translations.kjv: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
translations.asv: In days to come shall Jacob take root; Israel shall blossom and bud; and they shall fill the face of the world with fruit.
